name: Arrive
title: Through the Gate
lede: Every visit begins at the Sales Pavilion, where your QR wristband is issued. Then the Village opens ahead of you — caroling bands on your left, the Grotta Christmas Hotel on your right.
body: In the volcanic highlands of Musanze, Grotta Resort becomes a Christmas Village: open every day, from midday until ten at night.

name: Gather
title: Pull Up a Chair
lede: À la carte at the Frosted Restaurant. Hot wine and hot chocolate upstairs at Elf's Bar. Waffles, BBQ and pilau from the outdoor stalls, and popcorn and cotton candy by the cinema.
note: Every purchase is made with your QR wristband — outlets don't take cash, Mobile Money or cards directly.
footnote: Final menus and allergen information are being completed. Guests with allergies should speak to the outlet lead before ordering.

name: Wonder
title: Letters, Films & Small Wonders
lede: Write to Santa. Settle in for a film. Make something with your hands, then go and meet the animals.

items.name: Santa's Office
items.text: Children write their letters — and post them to Santa.

items.name: North Pole Cinema
items.text: Films and a small stage in the activity tent, with EZfun crafts and interactive digital games.

items.name: The Nativity
items.text: A quieter place for photographs and reflection.

partner: EZfun is the Village's confirmed partner for children's crafts and interactive digital games.
note: Age suitability, capacity and caregiver rules for individual activities are communicated on-site.

name: Water & Play
title: Swim, Then Play On
lede: The pool is part of the Village — the one the map draws as the Candy Cane Pool — with a children's pool for younger swimmers. Then the sports cluster, the playground and the bouncy castle.
note: Pool access is subject to operating capacity, supervision and safety rules. Towels are RWF 5,000 plus a refundable deposit.

name: Into the Cave
title: The Way Out Is Through the Cave
lede: The journey ends underground. A guided cave route leads toward the resort entrance — then the Grinch area and photobooth, and caroling at the exit, the same sound that welcomed you in.
